rows.cause: FC-METER: antd writes the fill width as an INLINE `width: 40%` (plus `--progress-percent`), runtime geometry the Option B exclusion refuses by name (geometry-excluded receipt in the extension). The fill is percent/max of its track — the schema's `meter` fact (the astryx/polaris progress-bar spelling); the canvas draws the defaults' fraction (40/100) and names the runtime sizing as a code-only fact.

The fill's height is antd's INLINE `height: 8px` (the default strokeWidth), refused as runtime geometry; without it the fill has no box on the canvas. 8px is antd's documented default line stroke width.

The track (`.ant-progress-inner`) wraps the inline-sized fill and measures 8px tall from it — geometry the capture refuses; the track needs its height to draw as a bar (antd's remaining-colour track).
